name: Consecrated Things
overview: The Scriptures in Numbers 18 reveal that consecrated things are set apart by God as holy and given to Aaron and his descendants as a perpetual ordinance because of their anointing. These include various offerings such as heave offerings, meat offerings, sin offerings, and trespass offerings, which are reserved from the fire and designated as most holy. The passage emphasizes that these consecrated gifts—best portions of oil, wine, wheat, and firstfruits—are to be consumed only by those who are ceremonially clean within the priestly household, highlighting the sacred stewardship entrusted to God's appointed ministers.
